senses.sense_definition: De wettelijke leeftijd waarop iemand in Nederland recht krijgt op een algemene ouderdomsuitkering.

examples.text: De <w>AOW-leeftijd</w> wordt de komende jaren stapsgewijs verhoogd.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>state pension age</w> will be increased in stages over the coming years.

examples.text: Veel mensen werken langer door omdat de <w>AOW-leeftijd</w> steeds verder opschuift.

target_lang_translations.en: Many people continue working longer because the <w>state pension age</w> keeps shifting further.

target_lang_definitions.en: The statutory age at which a person in the Netherlands becomes entitled to a state old-age pension.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The standard term for the age at which one qualifies for government-provided retirement benefits.
The general age at which people stop working and start receiving pension benefits.
